outcome.answer: For LLM-based prediction of item popularity for recommendation, TRAIL jointly predicts short-term popularity and generates natural-language explanations, using contrastive learning to align predictions with trend signals [1]. It reports outperforming strong baselines [1]. Related work uses popularity as a signal for selective LLM ranking supervision, activating it when the model predicts the LLM is reliable [3], while another LLM recommendation framework addresses popularity bias to improve fairness and accuracy [8].
